_default.fees: Tuition for government-placed students is shared between a Universities Fund scholarship (30% to 70%, depending on your funding band), a HELB loan, and your household. The exact amount depends on the programme, so check this university's official fee structure. The KUCCPS application fee is Ksh 1,500 and is non-refundable.
_default.deadline: The 2026/2027 KUCCPS application window ran from 7 April to 6 May 2026 and has closed. Check KUCCPS for the next cycle's dates.
